scientific_integrity: Analytical proof of the exact one-dimensional reduction, the sharp threshold and critical equality classes; the finite checker is supplemental, not a continuum proof.
scientific_limitations: Counting-measure norms only; only the Euclidean-input exponent line; no uniqueness assertion for the broken branch above the critical exponent; published literature priority not independently certified.
title: Exact first-order symmetry breaking for the \(\ell_2\)-to-\(\ell_q\) six-cycle incidence norm
